summary: Full E2E run for PAIMANA. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (dashboard, projects list/search/filter, project detail, 404, alerts, upload validation, upload with non-Table6 PDF, idempotent upload). Frontend: All 6 pages load; navigation works; Home KPIs, Dashboard KPIs+charts, Projects table (8 rows), Project detail with historical bar chart, Data Management upload UI, Early Warning placeholder all render correctly. Found one clear frontend bug in the filter dropdowns key mismatch.

ui_bugs.issue: Filter dropdowns (Ministry/Sector/State) render ONLY the 'All …' option and never populate values. Root cause: App.js line 24 reads data.filters?.[k+'s'] (i.e. 'ministrys','sectors','states') but backend /api/projects returns filters keyed as 'ministry','sector','state'. The map yields undefined so no options are appended. Also the label text 'All ministrys' is grammatically wrong.

issues: Dropdown placeholder pluralization: 'All ministrys' / 'All sectors' / 'All states' should read 'All ministries' etc.

action_items: Fix Projects filter key: change `data.filters?.[k+'s']` to `data.filters?.[k]` in /app/frontend/src/App.js (Projects component). Also fix the placeholder label to proper plural ('ministries').
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a single 31-line ultra-dense file – hard to read and maintain. Consider splitting each page into its own module for readability, though not a functional bug.

server.py `store_pdf` uploads every incoming PDF to remote object storage BEFORE validating/parsing. If the storage service is temporarily down, uploads fail with a 500 even for valid PDFs. Consider making storage optional or after successful parse.
server.py filters query builds SQL with %s params correctly, but multiple sequential DISTINCT queries could be batched.
server.py `seed_demo` writes rows to Supabase on every cold-start when table is empty – idempotent because of PK, but consider guarding behind an env flag for prod.

Frontend has no loading/error states for Projects and Detail pages beyond an empty table / plain 'Loading…' text – errors from /api/projects are silently swallowed to empty state, hiding real API failures from users.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 8 projects (PRJ-2026-001..008) with 3 months of history each on startup when projects table is empty. No test-created rows persisted beyond that (upload tests used a PDF containing no Table 6, so 0 rows inserted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully verified via pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_paimana_api.py. Note: the upload test uses a dummy PDF (no Table 6) so it only validates that /api/upload doesn't 500. Upload was NOT verified end-to-end with a real Table 6 report because constructing a matching pdfplumber-extractable table PDF is non-trivial. If main agent adds a fixture with a real report PDF, the upload/UPSERT/idempotency should also be covered.
rca of the issue: Projects filter dropdowns empty: In App.js Projects component, options mapper is `(data.filters?.[k+'s']||[]).map(...)`. Backend returns filters object keyed by singular names ('ministry','sector','state'), so lookup for 'ministrys' returns undefined → falls back to []. Fix: replace `[k+'s']` with `[k]` (and fix placeholder text plural).
